status: frozen before prospective v2 inference; immutable run policy

execution_order.rule: Repository blocks retain fixed cohort order; sort arm names by SHA256(seed + NUL + instance ID + NUL + arm). No output-dependent reordering.

codegraph.daemon: default enabled; do not set CODEGRAPH_NO_DAEMON

artifact.version_label: 0.2.4 source candidate; not the public PyPI wheel

codenib.substitution: Do not replace the graph route with grep/Jev or silently count BM25/native fallback as graph benefit.

agent.system_prompt: unmodified claude_code preset plus identical repository-environment context; retain each MCP server actual instructions and schemas
agent.session_schedule: Cold lookup session, then a fresh return session for flow/impact/repair/post-edit. Keep that return MCP connection through the controlled edit. Never share conversations across arms or repositories.

runtime.architecture: linux/arm64/v8 for task shells, product tools and new native controls
runtime.network: bridge only during neutral/project preparation and product setup; new network-none container for model and MCP, with both daemon mode and Config.NetworkDisabled inspected
runtime.mounts: only this workflow checkout; no Docker socket, home, credentials, controller files, other arm or grading material
runtime.shell: native Bash command quoted with shlex.join into the exact owned container ID
runtime.native_files: Native Read/Grep/Glob/Edit/Write scoped to own checkout. Native Read and Grep also admit only hash-verified native Bash output files in the exact SDK-owned session tool-results directory; other outside access remains denied.

common_prerequisites.python: 3.13.18 tool runtime; target conda environments from pinned native harness
common_prerequisites.neutral_preparation: source copy and common target project/test dependencies occur before the product-cold clock; record separately. Language/agent runtimes are pre-existing prerequisites in every arm.
common_prerequisites.source: same pinned one-commit checkout; no future Git objects or native reference/test patches in model access
common_prerequisites.version_binding: Pinned immutable neutral images from v1, with the same explicit target/test Python installation per case. Match target metadata within a repository; match selected product/provider identities to the source-admission receipts before inference.

runtime.requests_tests: Use the supplied pytest launcher for local offline HTTPbin HTTP/HTTPS services and temporary CA-data overlay/restoration; python -m pytest bypasses service startup. Supply the same context to all arms.
runtime.tool_registration: Only actual container-local native Claude CLI registration. Runtime SDK MCP configuration uses docker exec for that same owned server; no host client-profile writes.
runtime.setup_failure: Preserve exact failure and elapsed setup cost, leave only available native tools if the ordinary optional-tool setup fails, and continue tasks without switching products. The installed own CLI remains available in Bash; retries chosen by the model count as task work.
runtime.shell_output_files: Copy only each verified SDK-owned Bash output file into the same exact path in this owned container, compare its SHA256, and make the copy read-only. This preserves ordinary native Bash reads of its own output without mounting a profile or another session. Record the mapping and captured bytes; output caps still govern actual model delivery.
runtime.offline_python_provider: Prepare cached pinned Pyright during counted product setup; set UV_OFFLINE=1 only in the network-none runtime. Serena UV_CONSTRAINT binds the standalone child provider as well.
runtime.container_ownership: Record the container ID returned by create before start/verification. Inspect owner/limits before use, rebind the active workspace once and mask only other inherited volume destinations. Remove only returned owned IDs in finally.

time_and_attempts.attempts: One planned attempt per task; keep every start, tool error, timeout, terminal, partial patch and unattempted remainder. No controller retries or model substitutions after results.
time_and_attempts.fatal_sdk_terminal: Fail that task and stop the remaining workflow; retain every remaining task as unattempted. Ordinary tool errors may be recovered by the agent within the same phase bounds.
time_and_attempts.quota_or_billing_change: Stop starting workflows; retain the incomplete cohort and all attempts. Do not switch model, authentication route or task membership. Missing paired observations block a benefit claim.
time_and_attempts.read_only: Lookup/flow/impact/post-edit must preserve source bytes. Record source versions before and after each phase; an unexpected source change fails that read-only task. Capture the repair patch before injecting the controlled edit.

primary.name: complete five-task workflow wall time, summed over all three paired repositories
primary.clock: Start before arm-specific package installation/indexing/native registration; stop after final SDK session close. Include both session startups, all model/native/MCP calls, agent-chosen rebuild/reconnect work and controlled-edit application. Exclude separately recorded common machine/source/project-dependency preparation and later controller grading.
primary.failures: Retain observed elapsed time. For each rejected, timed-out or unattempted task add max(0, frozen task deadline minus observed task elapsed) to form the penalized primary total; no zero-time omitted failures.
primary.alternative: Find maximum accepted-task count among alternatives; among alternatives attaining it with no serious source/correctness error, select the smallest complete penalized cohort time. No eligible complete alternative means insufficient evidence.
primary.promotion: CodeNib accepted count must be at least that maximum, have no additional serious error on any paired task, and improve the primary cohort total by at least 20%; secondary normalized model usage must not worsen more than 10%. G1 correctness and external repeat-use gates remain separate.
primary.units: Three paired repository workflows; fifteen task observations are not independent samples. Publish all paired outcomes and observed cluster ratios; exploratory bootstrap uses repository resampling, seed above, 10000 draws and a 95% interval, with no population non-inferiority claim.

secondary.formula: For each SDK session take final cumulative model_usage counters once; sum inputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + outputTokens across main and all auxiliary models. Sum the two sessions and all repository workflows. Never sum cumulative per-phase results within the return session. thinkingTokens are already part of outputTokens and are not added again.
secondary.incomplete: Retain available counters as lower bounds; missing final usage prevents the complete secondary gate and is never zero.
secondary.money: Retain per-model costUSD and total_cost_usd as client estimates, separate from invoices. No per-task cash savings claim from included-plan usage.
secondary.http_requests: SDK turns and main-model stream steps are not complete HTTP request counts; keep unknown unless independently observed.

budget.route: existing native Max account; no supplied API key, included-only rate events; no automatic paid fallback
budget.sessions: Return-session cap is 20 minus the cold-session final estimate. Stop if a preceding session has missing final usage.
budget.preflights: Keep all probe estimates and missing-usage attempts separate; do not call their actual invoice zero.

grading.repair: Pinned unmodified SWE-bench Verified 4.1.0 tests/parser/grading, with existing owned image adapter; use the confirmed native arm64 control images. Reference patches/test patches and grading output stay outside all model inputs. Grade captured model repair patches after model execution.
grading.explanations: Apply every frozen criterion against the actual source version and captured delivered observations. Unsupported material caller/flow/order/propagation claims, fabricated source and presenting stale data as current are serious errors. Missing coverage or citations without an affirmative false claim fails task acceptance without automatically becoming a serious error.
grading.source_credit: No complete ContextBench source-read score is claimed. Requested ranges, assistant summaries, elided output and arbitrary shell text are not attributed reads without a verified captured-version mapping.
grading.subgroups: Lookup, flow+impact, repair and post-edit are prespecified descriptive groups. Share non-phase workflow overhead equally across its five tasks when reporting group costs; label the five-task amortization assumption. Whole-cohort promotion remains the primary gate.

terminal.cap_rule: An output/turn/budget/error/timeout terminal is not accepted even if partial text or patch exists. Never change these rules after observing v2 results.

criterion_change.original_criterion: Identify call_runtest_hook and collect_one_node as production CallInfo.from_call call sites.
criterion_change.corrected_criterion: Identify call_runtest_hook and pytest_make_collect_report as direct CallInfo.from_call call sites; explain collect_one_node as upstream hook-dispatch entry and report consumer.
criterion_change.reason: collect_one_node has no from_call invocation; the direct collection call is pytest_make_collect_report at runner.py:253. The original wording confuses an upstream entry/consumer with a direct site.

source_review.scope: Twelve explanation tasks, forty criteria, forty-eight pinned source definitions/tests; no model answer or reference patch enters the SDK input.

remaining_admission: Execute and grade this separately frozen cohort while preserving every v1 observation
Complete broader provider/representative workflow evidence and five-user seven-day repeat-use evidence before promotion

official_configuration_sources.facts: Exact main model ID; adaptive thinking always enabled; medium effort available; model maximum output 128K, with this run requesting 16384.
Automatic tool choice is supported; any/tool forced choice is rejected. The study does not force a product call.
SDK effort/thinking/MCP configuration and explicit terminal fields; installed SDK and CLI versions are separately bound.
Final cumulative session counters are counted once; SDK cost fields are estimates, distinct from authoritative billing.

supersedes.scope: Separate future cohort, never a replacement or rescore of v1
supersedes.reason: Source-checked direct-caller correction, current source candidate and verified unattended provider preparation. Preserve task membership/order, original prompts, primary/secondary rules, native grading and every old observation.
